content.title: Turn on notifications
content.copy: Introductions, Auto Match results, and event reminders. Nothing promotional.

approved_deltas: Use real operating-system notification status and real safe-area values.
Do not persist granted until the operating system returns granted.
Unsupported, denied, host-failure and persistence-failure states show truthful contextual text.
2026-10-26 user request: the custom buttons are Continue / Cancel. Continue directly calls the actual system notification request; system-owned dialog labels are unchanged.

Cancel makes no system request and never fabricates an OS denial. After the required custom Loading it persists only the onboarding choice, preserving an actual denied/unavailable status or otherwise marking setup skipped.
